Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity type, relation, value, units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id and docs on compound_records.doc_id to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter for human Aurora kinase A target, IC50 activity type, and require both a structure and a literature reference. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, activity type, relation, value, units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
